full_catalog_reference.basis: incoming source archive frozen before post-audit repair plus the exact reviewed ta.rma v5/v6 delta; this is a drift baseline and is not independent official Pine authority
full_catalog_reference.coverage: full serialized local definitions v1-v6 for drift detection only; does not establish external/official exhaustiveness

historical_policy.unverified_rows: must remain in the matrix with an owner; absence of external authority is not a pass
historical_policy.v1_v4: catalog snapshot retained and classified; modern v5/v6 input API is not backported

official_catalog_authority.acceptance_rule: Stage 2.1 is accepted when the complete public version/name denominator is pinned, every callable contract dimension remains represented, unknown dimensions stay explicitly UNVERIFIED, modern local extras are classified/fail-closed, and official migration/source provenance is intact. Independent full builtin behavior/TradingView oracle closure belongs to Stage 2.9.
official_catalog_authority.nonblocking_boundary: This authority does not claim exhaustive independent TradingView callable contracts or behavior; those UNVERIFIED dimensions remain in the denominator for Stage 2.9.

source_manifest.role: official documentation/migration source provenance; metadata-level evidence, not an exhaustive API body

authority.scope: Stage 2.1 complete version/name/contract denominator. Frozen incoming catalog is drift-only; official v5/v6 name indexes and verified v1-v6 source/migration provenance define the public denominator, while unsupported or not-independently-proved contract dimensions remain explicit UNVERIFIED.

contract_denominator.policy: Every public callable form has explicit parameter/overload/default/return/qualifier dimension cells. Missing independent proof remains UNVERIFIED and stays in the denominator; Stage 2.9 owns independent builtin behavior/oracle closure.

independent_reference.contract_depth: complete local contract denominator with explicit UNVERIFIED dimensions; frozen baseline remains drift-only evidence
